questions.input: Interviewer: How has your experience in urban planning influenced your views on community development? Interviewee: I began my career focusing on infrastructure, but over time, I've come to see community needs as central to successful planning. I've worked on projects that involved local residents in decision-making, which led to more inclusive outcomes. In closing, I believe that true development must be rooted in the lived experiences of the people it serves.
questions.response_prefix: The interviewee emphasizes the importance of community involvement in shaping equitable and sustainable urban development.

questions.input: Interviewer: What changes have you observed in the way people approach financial literacy over the past five years? Interviewee: Initially, financial education was seen as a one-size-fits-all approach, but now I see a shift toward personalized, accessible tools. questions.response_prefix: The interviewee highlights a shift toward personalized and context-based financial education as a more effective approach.
